title: GLHS R4 Phase 0 / E21: Formal Novelty Model & State-Space Assurance (Invariants I16–I24)
phase: Phase 0 — Prospective Experimental & Statistical Plan for R4
scientific_unit: distinct reachable state explored in bounded Python state-space model checker (explore_r4.py / model_r4.py)

primary_endpoints.name: GRWC Invariant Violations
primary_endpoints.definition: Total count of invariant violations (I16-I24) detected under GRWC bounded state-space exploration.

secondary_endpoints.name: Formal Mutation Testing Kill Rate
secondary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of injected formal specification mutants detected and killed by formal explorer.

secondary_endpoints.name: Counterexample Generation for C0/C1
secondary_endpoints.definition: Verification of deterministic counterexample witness generation demonstrating C0/C1 failure under identical commit-time DB state.

sample_size.unit_definition: 162 distinct reachable states explored in bounded state-space model checker up to search depth d=5

statistical_plan.method: Exhaustive Bounded State-Space Exploration and Model-Checking Mutation Analysis

stopping_rules.fail_closed_criteria: Halt submission if formal explorer finds any invariant violation under GRWC up to depth d=5.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Failure to complete exploration to depth d=5 fails the formal verification gate.
